name: evidence-search
description: Answer questions from a project's code, requirements, design documents and configuration with cited path:line evidence at low token cost: tiered search, bounded grep, mandatory cross-checks for enumeration and absence questions, requirement-to-code tracing, and an evidence ledger. Ships an optional local index: SQLite FTS5 BM25 search with identifier-aware terms, tree-sitter method chunks for Java and JavaScript, heading sections for Markdown and AsciiDoc, a repo map, and a fact table of SQL tables, URLs, JSP includes, queues, config keys and project ids such as requirement numbers. Works on code that does not compile.
